test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number series and answer the given question (all numbers are single-digit numbers only). Counting should be done from left to right only.

(Left) 1 8 1 5 3 8 5 2 5 2 3 3 7 4 4 5 2 7 8 7 2 (Right)

How many odd numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and immediately followed by an odd number?
solution:
**Given:** (Left) 1 8 1 5 3 8 5 2 5 2 3 3 7 4 4 5 2 7 8 7 2 (Right)

Now,

Odd numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and immediately followed by an odd number.

So, the needed pattern is: Even — Odd — Odd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e23e8e158cfceff4745adff3e3d9efa563f4ed75e1054b4f24be02deacd1ce1.png] Thus, there are two odd numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and immediately followed by an odd number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
